newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: NEDCOR CUTS PRIME TO 19.25 PCT FROM OCT 1.
newsitem.headline: NEDCOR CUTS PRIME TO 19.25 PCT FROM OCT 1.

text.p: Nedcor Ltd announced on Thursday that it would cut its prime overdraft rate by 25 basis points to 19.25 percent with effect from October 1.
Nedcor was the last of South Africa's "Big Four" commercial banks to cut its rate after Standard Bank Investment Corp set the trend on Wednesday afternoon.
First National Bank Holdings Ltd and Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd cut their prime overdraft rates by the same margin on Thursday morning.
The South African government's decision to scrap the Financial Services Levy on October 1 and replace it with value added tax on financial services has been cited as the reason for the move.
The levy was first introduced by government in 1991, when banks increased prime by 0.25 percent to recover the cost.
